senses.gloss:
n. (-त्यं)
1 Evil doing, wickedness.
2 Repentance.
E.
कु bad, कृत्या action, affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
1 A hypocrite.
2 A kind of mendicant, one who does not look far before him, or who proceeds with his eyes fixed upon the ground, for fear of treading upon insects, &c.
E.
कुक्कुटी hypocrisy, or a small part, ठक् aff.

m. (-लः)
A species of snake, the Boä or Bor.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Abdominal, ventral.
E.
कुक्षि the belly, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A sword, a scymitar.
E.
कुक्षि the belly, and ढकञ् affix; in any other sense the affix is अण्, making कौक्ष.
